description: This file declares the UserService interface, which provides core methods for managing users and roles within the insurance management backend. It includes method signatures for creating users, assigning roles, finding users by email, listing roles, and toggling user status.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Interface defining core user management and role assignment operations.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified full name, email, raw password, and roles.

methods.name: assignRoles
methods.description: Assigns roles to an existing user identified by userId.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a user by email address, returning an Optional<User>.

methods.name: listRoles
methods.description: Lists all roles available in the system.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a user account based on the enabled flag.
